purpose: Eliminate repeated manual issuer-identity rescue for genuinely prospective ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE filings by deriving only high-confidence static issuer identity from immutable official CNInfo announcement metadata, while preserving identity-only semantics and fail-closed behavior.

problem_elimination_pass.final_goal: Allow unseen issuers with a strictly provable official legal name to obtain one reusable static identity binding before identity-completion ratification, without manual per-issuer intervention.
hard_constraints: Only genuinely prospective observations may trigger automatic prebinding.
Only records already classified ELIGIBLE_AI_CORE and blocked solely by unresolved issuer identity may trigger automatic prebinding.
Identity evidence may never create, strengthen, recompute or alter AI classification.
Only immutable official CNInfo observation-result metadata already captured by the prospective pipeline may be consumed.
canonical_security_id and security_name must be internally consistent across the source run.
The issuer legal name must be uniquely derivable by direct extension of the exact security_name in official announcement_title text to an allowed Chinese corporate legal suffix.

At least one SUCCESS observation for the same canonical security must have an announcement_title beginning exactly with the derived issuer legal name, providing issuer-authored-title authority rather than relying only on third-party opinion titles.
If zero, multiple or conflicting legal names are derivable, no binding is written.
An existing binding with a different legal name blocks the operation.
Binding must be committed before any downstream ratifier uses it so git commit time remains the authoritative identity-completeness boundary.
No price, return, benchmark, outcome, fold3/fold4, Setup, First60, Episode, live or brokerage data/action may be accessed.
problem_elimination_pass.soft_constraint_removed: Every previously unseen issuer identity must be manually researched and inserted after a positive is blocked.

strict_derivation_rule.security_name_match: exact literal security_name occurrence; no fuzzy matching, alias expansion or abbreviation inference
strict_derivation_rule.issuer_authored_title_test: same canonical_security_id SUCCESS row whose announcement_title starts exactly with derived issuer_legal_name

binding_output.identity_evidence_text: exact immutable CNInfo announcement_title selected as issuer-authored authority

temporal_boundary.binding_authority_time: GitHub committed_at of the commit that first adds the binding ledger row
